prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1145; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Conroe, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a side impact. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that the traffic signal was green when entering the intersection. Driver 2 was operating an SUV westbound and reported that the signal had just changed to green for their direction. The front driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle struck the passenger side of Driver 1's sedan. A Passenger was seated in the front right seat of Driver 1's vehicle and did not report any injuries. Driver 1 stated that they were holding their left shoulder and believed it struck the door frame during impact. Driver 1 was evaluated at the scene and transported by EMS for further assessment. Both vehicles sustained significant damage and were towed from the roadway. Skid marks were noted on the pavement from Driver 2's vehicle. Traffic was redirected until the scene was cleared. Photographs were taken and statements were collected from all parties.
